cmd:
cd /root/Iryna_Karmazina && git pull -q origin main 2>&1 | tail -1
python3 - <<'PY'
c = open('/root/Caddyfile').read()
if '/cabinet-log' in c:
    open('/root/Caddyfile.new','w').write(c); print('CADDY: ВЖЕ Є')
else:
    block = "\thandle /cabinet-log* {\n\t\treverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:8793\n\t}\n"
    i = c.index('\thandle {')
    open('/root/Caddyfile.new','w').write(c[:i] + block + c[i:]); print('CADDY: ДОПИСАНО')
PY
cp /root/Caddyfile /root/Caddyfile.bak-cablog-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
diff /root/Caddyfile /root/Caddyfile.new
if docker run --rm -v /root/Caddyfile.new:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile:ro caddy:2-alpine \
     caddy validate --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile >/tmp/cv2.log 2>&1; then
  echo "VALIDATE_OK"
  cp /root/Caddyfile.new /root/Caddyfile
  docker exec caddy caddy reload --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "RELOAD_OK"
  systemctl restart unitex-cabinet && sleep 3
  echo "служба: $(systemctl is-active unitex-cabinet)"
  echo "UI: $(curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://134.209.94.12/)"
  echo "журнал без ключа (має бути 403): $(curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://134.209.94.12/cabinet-log)"
  bash /root/Iryna_Karmazina/server/deploy_ui.sh main 2>&1 | tail -5
else
  echo "VALIDATE_FAIL"; tail -4 /tmp/cv2.log
fi
